name: Spring dash stack: a straight-down dash through a second down spring keeps both momenta
techNote: spring-clip's ledge, ceiling and Course 5 ceiling spring pointing down (SpringScript upForce 70, strength 300; trigger at x 80-160, y 260-340, turned 180°), a second one under the ledge's right end (trigger at x 60-140, y -80-0, turned 180°), omnidash unlocked (WJ_DS_BS_ZIP_OM: a straight-down dash needs it). A dash moves momentum into preDashMomentum and zeroes it (1643-1644), so nothing decays for its ticks, and moves 33.4 u a tick. A spring hit mid-dash calls endDash first (hitSpring 2436-2439), which gives back 95% of preDashMomentum.y when its sign matches the dash's (2035-2037), then adds the spring's -575 and sets Velocity.y -270 (2474-2477): momentum.y -1109 after the hit (a fall through the same spring without the dash: -1013.4, 3 ticks later). A dash that ends in the air instead hits the dash-end brake: endDash sets Velocity.y to 10 whenever it is under 10 for a flat or down dash (2024-2027), so the down-right ghost starts its fall from +10 with momentum.y -522. A 32-tall spike strip (x -1260-1140, y -444 to -412) covers every way down with the finish box under it; the strip needs 28.67 u a tick (86 u in 3 ticks).

ghosts.label: Down-right dash past the spring: dash-end brake
No dash: plain fall through the spring
